datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Niger in 2013, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions under different scenarios, with classifications recorded at multiple time points (January, April, July, October) and distributed as geographic vector data.
